current_version: No version numbering. The Figma agent (on-canvas) and Weave tools moved from open beta to GA on Oct 6, 2026 and now consume AI credits. Oct 15, 2026 ('Build by design'): Code layers (open beta, all plans), Specs (open beta, paid plans, web/desktop/mobile), Guidelines (open beta, paid plans), Code sources from GitHub/npm (closed beta, paid plans), Payload CMS inside Figma Make (rolling out to all plans).
pricing: Starter free: 150 AI credits/day, up to 500/month. Professional: Full $16, Dev $12, Collab $3 per month billed annually, or $20 / $15 / $5 billed monthly; Full seat +3,000 AI credits/mo, Dev and Collab +500. Organization (billed annually): Full $55 (+3,500 credits), Dev $25, Collab $5. Enterprise (billed annually): Full $90 (+4,250 credits), Dev $35, Collab $5. AI credit add-ons were raised on Aug 25, 2026 to 2x credits on Professional and 1.6x on Organization/Enterprise at the same price.
free_tier: Yes: Starter plan with 150 AI credits/day, up to 500/month. The Figma agent has limited availability on Starter.
repositioning: Figma is moving toward agent-driven design: the GA Figma agent plus code-backed canvas (Code layers), shared context for agents (Specs, Guidelines) and Payload CMS in Make.
